item.title: Border health worker in Ticino: guide
item.description: Working as an OSS in Ticino: here are the requirements for the recognition of the title, the contribution rates and the operation of the new tax agreement.
item.content:encoded:
## In a nutshell - New Frontier Agreement in force from 1 January 2024. - The border worker pays the tax at source exclusively in Switzerland. - Recognition of qualifications necessary to operate in the health sector. - AVS/AI/IPG contributions set at 5.3% to be paid by the employee.
## Key facts - **What**: Profession of social health worker (OSS) in Ticino - When: New Frontier Agreement in force from 1 January 2024 - Where: Canton Ticino, Switzerland - Who: Frontier healthcare worker - AVS contribution: 5.3% to be paid by the employee - AD/AC contribution: 1.1% (cap CHF 148'200) - LAINF: 0.7-1.5% depending on the employer
Healthcare work in the Canton of Ticino is an increasingly important choice for healthcare professionals residing in Italy. To pursue this career, you need to understand the regulatory structure that governs the relationship between the two countries. The new tax agreement, signed on 23 December 2020 and in force from 1 January 2024, introduced substantial changes in the management of taxation for frontier workers. The Italian ratification took place through Law 83 of 13 June 2023. Pursuant to this legislation, tax at source is withheld only in Switzerland. To avoid double taxation, Italy allows the tax credit to be applied through the EC framework of model 730. It is essential to remember that Switzerland is not a member of the European Union or the Economic Area Analyzing the tax position for a social-health operator who crosses the border daily, for instance through the Brogeda or Gaggiolo crossings to healthcare facilities in the Canton of Ticino, requires attention to recent developments. With the entry into force of the new agreement on January 1, 2024, the distinction between 'old' and 'new' cross-border commuters has been consolidated. For those who were already cross-border commuters before July 17, 2023, a 7,500 euro exemption is provided under a transitional regime covering the 2024–2033 period. For new cross-border commuters, the exemption threshold is set at 10,000 euros. These thresholds directly influence the calculation of net income, as they determine the taxable base to which Italian IRPEF rates are applied. In Italy, IRPEF follows progressive brackets: 23% up to 28,000 euros, 35% for the bracket between 28,001 and 50,000 euros, and 43% for the portion exceeding 50,000 euros.
### Differences between taxation models Before 2024, the system was based on the 1976 Double Taxation Convention. Today, the new legislation governs the tax relationship more strictly. It is important to emphasize that the so-called 'health tax' does not exist; the cross-border commuter is required to take out health insurance (LAMal). LAMal is mandatory, and the worker has the right of option, choosing between different deductibles ranging from CHF 300 to CHF 2,500. This cost is borne by the worker and affects the household budget as much as taxes do. Comparing the situation with the past, the worker no longer needs to worry about double taxation, thanks to the tax credit mechanism that neutralizes the Swiss tax burden on the total amount due in Italy. To examine their situation in depth, the worker can use the [calculator](nav:calculator) to simulate the net salary. Financial planning thus becomes a necessary step to understand actual purchasing power, considering that the cost of living in Ticino differs from that of the Italian border areas. Using analytical tools allows for a correct assessment of the weight of contributions paid, such as AVS or the second pillar, relative to the future benefits guaranteed by the Swiss pension system.
## Useful tools for your case To verify your within/over 20 km tax scenario, use the [net salary calculator](nav:calculator) and the [tax return guide](nav:tax-return). For those wishing to pursue a career as a social-health operator (OSS) in Ticino, the procedure begins with the verification of professional requirements. The recognition of the Italian educational qualification is the mandatory first step. Once the qualification is obtained, the candidate must seek employment at healthcare facilities in the Canton of Ticino, such as EOC (Ente Ospedaliero Cantonale) hospitals or other private clinics. After receiving a job offer, the employer initiates the procedure for issuing the G permit, which authorizes the Italian citizen to work in Switzerland while maintaining residence in Italy. This permit must be requested from the competent cantonal offices, following the directives of the SEM (State Secretariat for Migration).
### Operations and Compliance Once hired, the cross-border commuter must regularize their insurance status. The choice of the health insurance fund for LAMal must be made within the prescribed deadlines by exercising the right of option. Failure to fulfill this obligation may result in penalties or the mandatory assignment to a health insurance fund with higher costs. In parallel, it is necessary to manage one's social security status, verifying that the employer regularly pays AVS and LPP contributions. It is good practice to keep every document related to payslips and taxes paid in Switzerland, as they will be necessary for filling out the CE section of the Italian tax return. Regular payments in Switzerland do not exempt the worker from the declaration obligation in Italy, where the Revenue Agency will evaluate the tax credit due. Those who travel daily to Ticino's care centers must also consider travel times and transport management. Although there are no traffic calculation tools, monitoring flows at border crossings can help optimize commutes. item.description: Critical analysis of the cinematographic work presented at the festival, between a stellar cast and a narrative defined as consolatory and inauthentic.
item.content:encoded:
## In a nutshell - Film presented in the circuit of film festivals - Cast composed of well-known actors from the Italian scene - The main protagonist is the actor Valerio Mastandrea - Work defined by critics as comforting and cunning
## Key facts - **What**: Movie titled Armony - Protagonist: Valerio Mastandrea - Genre: Cinematic work with a known cast - Critical judgment: Film disguised as a committed work
The film 'Armony' has recently come to the attention of film critics, bringing with it a heated debate on the nature of the work itself and the stylistic choices adopted by the production. The film is presented to the public with a cast of well-known actors, an element that usually guarantees a certain visibility and interest from the viewers. Leading the group of performers is Valerio Mastandrea, an actor who confirms himself, also on this occasion, in a solid and convincing acting form.
### Analysis of the narrative structure Despite the technical quality of the interpreters, the overall judgment expressed by industry observers points the finger at a script that appears, on the whole, cunning. The work seems to seek an emotional shortcut, focusing on consoling tones that end up emptying the content of that real depth that would be expected from a film that tries to present itself as a committed work. Critics point out that the disguise of an 'auteur film' The analysis of the work reveals a clear gap between the expectations created by the stellar cast and the final result projected on the screen. The presence of leading actors, such as Mastandrea, often raises the level of acting, but fails to compensate for a direction that appears oriented towards a narrative that is all too accommodating. In a cinematic context that requires depth, 'Armony' chooses the simplest path, that of a narrative that wants to reassure the viewer rather than interrogate him or stimulate critical reflection.
### The contrast between form and substance The main problem encountered by critics lies in this constant 'disguise'. The work wants to appear engaged, it uses the aesthetic codes of social or introspective cinema, but in fact the structure remains linked to purely commercial and consolatory dynamics. This approach is perceived as a limit, since it prevents the film from acquiring that solidity necessary to leave a lasting mark on the viewer's memory. The form, purely technical and well cared for thanks to the cast, does not find a counterpart in the substance of the messages conveyed by the film. The perception is that of an operation built at the table to meet the favor of the general public, sacrificing the intellectual honesty of the story on the altar of a reassuring vision and devoid of harshness, making it difficult, for criticism, to forgive the choices

The drought affected hay production in Switzerland, forcing the DEFR to intervene. From 15 September to 31 October 2026 it will be possible to import fresh or silage maize intended for animals with dry matter ≤60% without paying duties. The Federal Office for Agriculture (FOAG) has already eliminated duties on hay and grass silage as of 1 August 2026 under the ordinary legislation.
